allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Company has informed about acquisition of 36,00,000 equity shares of Aeroflex Neu Limited upon Conversion of Warrants

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Aeroflex Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the allotment of 79,200 Equity shares under the SAT Industries Limited Employee Stock Option Plan 2024

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: The Board of Director's of the Company has decided to acquire a stake in M/s. Dev Information Technology Limited, a public listed company, by way of a strategic investment, through a mix of equity shares and/or warrants convertible into equity shares.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Aeroflex Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Revised Intimation - Allotment of Convertible Warrants by Subsidiary Company'.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Aeroflex Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding - The Intimation received by the from its subsidiary Company,  Aeroflex Neu Limited (formerly Sah Polymers Limited), regarding the allotment of 72,00,000 Convertible Warrants at ₹90/- each.The warrants were issued to promoters and non-promoters under Chapter V of SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, 2018 for business expansion and growth.Out of the above, the Company has subscribed to 36,00,000 Convertible Warrants on a preferential basis.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Sat Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Grant of Stock Options under SIL Employee Stock Option Plan 2024 ( the Scheme )
